output.reason: The release note alone [ev-8f8896a282cf] reads like a test-only fix, but the linked PR [ev-40753290bb72] states a product change. The package revision controller now waits for the runtime controller to set a TLS secret before establishing webhooks, CRDs and similar resources (cherry-picked from #6603, fixing issue #6606). The changed files [ev-620f31ed34ef] include internal/controller/pkg/revision/establisher.go, so this goes beyond the E2E test code. The other half of the PR [ev-cb6130fa3561] only touches test code (it explicitly waits for child resources to be deleted). That gives an engineer the subject (the package revision establisher), the change (a new ordering rule: wait for the TLS secret before establishing APIs) and the applicability (package revisions that establish webhooks/CRDs). Confidence is low because the bug in issue #6606 is not shown, so exactly which packages are affected has to be inferred.
